draft.letter_text: Dear Prime Video, I am disputing the $9.99 charge on my card for a month I did not use. I request a full refund. Please investigate and resolve this matter promptly. I have no payment history on file with your service. I look forward to a resolution.
steps: Check your account to see if you were logged in or had any active subscriptions
Contact Prime Video's merchant support to explain the issue
Escalate to Your bank's dispute team if Prime Video does not resolve the issue
Gather evidence of your inactivity during the disputed period
Submit a dispute with Your bank's dispute team if Prime Video does not refund you
If Your bank's dispute team cannot resolve the issue, consider contacting the Australian Financial Complaints Authority
Cancel the subscription from the app's account page to stop future charges.

reason: Charged for a month I did not use
